verdict.rationale: Helicone's webhooks fire automatically when LLM requests complete. They can be filtered so that only requests matching all specified properties trigger them, which lets users automate workflows and scoring. Alerts add threshold-based monitoring on error rates and costs, and gateway features like fallbacks and token-limit handlers apply automatic strategies. This is limited event-triggered automation rather than a general rules engine. Missing for 10: a general rule builder with multiple event types and configurable actions, conditions beyond property matching, documentation of alert actions and destinations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
